scenario: LSIG.3.4 CC-3: `integral … gap skip` on a `scope logical` schema is a compile error — gap skip needs a bounded scope (`scope ttl` / `scope explicit`) so a fact can go dead between assertions.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Flow scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    q: Float mutable

series Flow.q:
    integral sliding 5_min gap skip

rule r:
    Flow
->
    log info "x"
